premise: CYDL sells to people with no clean socks. Hamper'd sells to people with no time. So the hook is never 'we can tell your place is a mess' — it is the hours. Every post prices the part of the week laundry quietly takes, then hands it back. Warm and family-run rather than deadpan and clever.
not_this_brand: CYDL (cleanyourdirtylaundry.com) is the sibling campus brand. Its navy/powder palette, Archivo Black, heart-tag lockup, Pile and Bag characters, $100/mo student price and deadpan student voice must never appear here.

posts.name: What A Sunday Costs

slides.sub: Add it up once. You will not want to add it up twice.
Before a single machine has run.
In front of something you are not really watching.
Let us be honest about this one.
{{PRICE}} a month, flat. Back in 24 to 48 hours, folded.

posts.caption:
Add up one Sunday. Sorting, twenty minutes. Wash and dry, three hours of waiting. Folding, forty-five minutes. Putting it away — tomorrow, probably.

That is most of a day, every week, for as long as you live in that house.

Or: one bag on the porch. {{PRICE}} a month, flat.
